title: Mcp Design Viewer Respects Show Design And Show Scene Modes
description: normalizeMcpDiagramPayload dropped mode/design/kit; McpDesignViewer defaulted to diagram and kit-only branch order wrong. Preserve fields, score richer payloads, render SemioDesign/SemioScene first.
summary: normalizeMcpDiagramPayload now passes through mode, design, and kit from engine JSON; scoreMcpDiagramPayload favors those fields so bestMcpDiagramPayload does not drop them for stripped structuredContent. McpDesignViewer evaluates show-design/show-scene before the kit-only (!hasDiagram) branch. Vitest: preserves mode/design/kit. Engine tool docstrings already describe split design vs diagram vs scene. Rebuilt dist/mcp-app.html.
